title: Limits Of Longing
paragraphs: “Oh…”
When I looked ahead, I saw men in robes staring at me in shock.
How many times have I seen this scene? Every time I’m here, I’m struck by an instinctive urge to take down Ren and Itsuki, but I must resist. First, I need to organize the situation.
What was the cause of the previous loop? Nothing immediately comes to mind, but I’m sure there was a reason.

No… I have a vague idea. In the first world… it might be the moment when I died. In other words, no matter how many times I loop, I can’t go beyond the time of my death. I need to think about how much I can accomplish within that limited time. I am a hero and a hunter who is devoted to my love for Filo-tan. Just because time is limited doesn’t mean I will stop moving forward. Within this time frame, I will reunite with Filo-tan and remain true to my love. Bringing peace to the world is my mission, but I only need to achieve that peace within the given time. Well, there’s no point in worrying about it. The world of the previous loop might still be continuing. My rival denies it, but I won’t give up. I’ll stay positive and believe that even if I’m not there, Father and the others will continue fighting to protect the world in my stead. For now, I need to sort out what needs to be done. First, I must earn Ren and Itsuki’s trust. This has been a proven success, so there’s no need to change it. After that, I’ll proceed according to the steps that Father and the others laid out, based on what I learned in the previous loop. If I fail, I just need to keep moving forward, and the future will open up.
But still… where in the world is Filo-tan?
In the previous loop, I raised over 500 Filolials! Filo-tan, Filo-tan, Filo-tan…
How many miracles were needed to create someone like you?
My longing is reaching its limit!
“Hey.”
I snap back to reality after feeling a few pokes.
“Filo-tan!”
“Huh!?”

In front of me, Father was staring at me with a stunned expression. Ren and Itsuki were also giving me puzzled looks. Ah, I feel like jumping on Father. If I don’t get to smell Filo-tan soon, I might go insane.
“Forgive me, I was lost in thought.”
“Spacing out in this situation… I can’t say I don’t understand, but is it the shock from the summoning?”

Father tilted his head and asked in a tone that was lighter and less kind than before. Come to think of it, Father was like this in the beginning. He’s someone who becomes kinder when others show him kindness. Ah, I feel a bit nostalgic for the Father from the first world, who would look at me with disdain and call me Motoyasu by name.
Maybe I should ask him to do that in this loop as well? Either way, for now, I need to play my part.
“My name is Motoyasu Kitamura. I’m 21 years old, a college student.”
“What’s with that ‘desu zo’…”
“Aren’t you getting a little too excited?”

Ren is the same as ever. Acting cool but likely to walk a disappointing path. For now, Father and the others have warned me to use the previous loop as a reference to some extent. If I cause a commotion here, Ren will grow even more suspicious of me, so I’ve been warned not to stand out. And I absolutely must not point out someone’s complexes immediately after the summoning.
“I can’t deny I have that side to me.”
“For that, you seem oddly spaced out… such a strange person.”

Itsuki wore a gentle smile, but at that time, he was apparently intoxicated by his own luck. He was supposedly thinking about how to become stronger without standing out as much as possible. Of course, he was skeptical when he realized this world resembled a game, but that was only natural.
“Hmm… Ren, Motoyasu, and Itsuki, huh.”
“Your Majesty, you forgot me.”
“Oh, my apologies. Naofumi-dono.”

I should act according to the advice from Father in the previous and the one before that. Eventually, when we were taken to the room and Father and the others were examining the weapons, they were grinning. Come to think of it, this time Father mentioned that if the plan goes well, I’ll have a certain degree of freedom. However, according to the Queen, it’s preferable to stay in Melromarc after gaining a certain amount of strength. For that reason, it’s best to stay somewhere where we can fend off the Three Heroes Church’s assassins. Right now, I have portals to most countries. If I wanted, I could take everyone to Faubrey on the first day. If I ask Father and the others about party formation here, I could easily become the leader and take them all to Faubrey. However, there’s Takt and his group. Bringing Father and the others, who are still at level 1, into such a situation would be dangerous, and I’ve been warned to avoid that to ensure we can work together properly. Now, that night, I had almost the same conversation as in the previous loop. I had Ren and Itsuki question whether Father was really the weakest. And then, during mealtime…
Father was eating with a curious expression, as if thinking how different the food of this world was, so I casually spoke up.
“Fa—uh, Naofumi, what do you think of the food here?”
“Huh? Well, it has a strange taste.”
Itsuki nodded in agreement with Father’s impression.
“Yeah, it’s surprising because it’s different from what I imagined.”
“In games, food only boosted stats visually, but in reality, it’s like this, huh?”

Ren commented as he ate. …Father wasn’t very interested in the food conversation. That’s right. Father never realized he was good at cooking. Perhaps because the previous loop lasted the longest, there’s still a sense of discrepancy.
“I wonder how they get this kind of flavor.”
“Motoyasu, you’re curious about that?”
“Indeed. Fa—uh, Naofumi, do you know?”
“Hmm… I’m not sure since these are unfamiliar ingredients. It looks like an omelet, but it tastes kind of like an orange.”
“Ah, now that you mention it. What is this omelet-like dish?”
“It looks simple, so maybe the eggs themselves taste like orange. But… it’s more of a curiosity than something truly delicious.”
Father analyzed the dish as he explained.

“And this dish here… the base is curry, I think? But instead of multiple spices, it tastes like vegetables boiled and seasoned with herbs and oil… It’s not spicy like curry, but it has a strange spiciness. On the other hand, what’s this meat that looks like chicken?”
Father pointed at the meat with his fork and knife. T-This is…

“Umm… I can sense a bit of a gamey smell. I think they did a good job masking it. But… it’s not chicken, and it doesn’t taste like turkey either. It’s not ostrich meat, as the texture feels different… what is it?”
“It’s… Filolial meat.”
That’s right. Only in the first world did I unknowingly eat Filolial meat. Since then, I have never touched it in any of the loops.
“Filolial? Is that a monster of this world?”
“Probably. There are bird-type monsters used for mounts and pets. In Motoyasu’s game, that’s what they were called.”
“I see. But how did you figure that out?”
Gulp… This is bad. I need to play it off smoothly to avoid suspicion.
“I just had a feeling.”
“I see… but to think this is it.”
Ren and Itsuki are munching on the Filolial meat. Every time they do, I feel a surge of murderous intent, but I’m holding back for now.
“But Naofumi-san, you seem oddly knowledgeable. Have you ever eaten ostrich meat before?”

“A college friend of mine brought it once, saying it was an unusual ingredient. I cooked it myself. I read online that it tends to harden quickly, so I had to be careful. I guess the meat had a peculiar flavor.”
“I see.”
Soon after, a slightly larger roasted lizard was brought out. No matter how many loops I’ve been through, Ren and Itsuki were always taken aback at this point.
“It doesn’t seem like an alligator or a monitor lizard. Maybe a dragon?”
And yet, Father boldly ate that meat without hesitation. That really left an impression. I was also taken aback at first. I wondered if he had ever eaten alligator or monitor lizard before.
“Na… Naofumi?”
“Hm? What’s wrong?”
“N-No… it’s nothing.”

Ren and Itsuki were stunned, watching Father adapt so quickly. After finishing our meal, we returned to our rooms to sleep. Of course, before going to bed, I went to visit the Filolials. Otherwise, I wouldn’t be able to fall asleep.

Ahh… I’m really craving the scent of Filo-tan. Maybe I should mix the scent of Father’s clothes and Sakura-chan’s and take a sniff. I even considered sneaking Father’s clothes while he was asleep. The next morning, after waking up in the Filolial shed, I reunited with Father and the others.
“Motoyasu, don’t you smell a little weird?”
Father always says that at this point
